title: How to use ChatGPT to negotiate your salary

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know ChatGPT can help you negotiate a better salary?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: With AI-driven job markets, salary transparency is more important than ever.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: ChatGPT can generate custom, data-backed salary negotiation letters in seconds.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It uses real-time industry data from platforms like Glassdoor and PayScale.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects everyone in tech, especially those underpaid in entry-level roles.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Remember: leverage AI to back your worth with facts, not just feelings.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to see how? Drop a comment below and I’ll show you step-by-step.
